mainLiftTest.description: Add weight when every set reaches the top of the rep range at RPE 8 or lower.

accessoryRule.description: Add reps up to the top of the range first, then the smallest weight jump for that equipment.

stall.description: Two consecutive sessions that fail the test: drop 10% and rebuild.
stall.message: Second miss in a row. Check sleep, food and ski load.

baseline.description: Week 1: work up to a set of 5 with 2 reps left on each main lift; train at about 90% of it for weeks 1-2. Clean: work up in doubles to a crisp, fast weight.

heavy.description: Main lifts move to 3-5 reps. First heavy-week target = last 4-6 target plus 5%, rounded to the increment (assumption, editable).

retest.description: Main lifts: work up to a 5-rep set at RPE 8-9. Also max strict pull-ups, max unbroken toes-to-bar, 5K time.

rampUp.description: Ramp-up sets before a main lift. Fractions of the target weight; empty bar first.

trim.description: Trim to fit, applied in order when the projected finish is past the cap. Cameron confirms before it applies.
